title: Giran (Nether boss)
problem: Adds % of allies' stats to all its stats, but every stat reads Attack.
notes: Fix: S: per-stat variable fix — in patch (byte-verified; 9 calls, tiers 1312/1313/1314) 2026-10-26 check: tier 1 loops bc_GetAlliesOf ('your other creatures'), tiers 2-3 loop global.creatureList, both sides ('all other creatures'); every Lifeblood holder is skipped inside the loop (no self-recursion, also safe for the crit_defense/intelligence/speed redirect). Matches the text; no further change.

release_notes.intended: Each of the boss's stats gains a share of the same stat from the other creatures.
release_notes.actual: In the unpatched game, every stat took its share from the others' Attack.
release_notes.fix: Now each stat reads the matching stat (Defense from Defense, Speed from Speed, and so on).
